parsed.post: Kept WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.03: val_bpb 1.0028 -> 1.0021. The warmup trend seems to hold even at this lower learning rate. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.02 to further probe the lower-LR trend on this D6/warmup0.05 base.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.02 on the DEPTH=6, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 configuration to see if the lower-LR trend continues to improve val_bpb.
